adapted_sources.name: OpenReel Video
adapted_sources.modifications: Loads an opt-in PBJ-projected OpenReel Project through OpenReel's existing project store, hydrates PBJ's mobile-safe per-source proxies sequentially with actual byte-size metadata and abortable requests, remembers a device-local last-project pointer only for Home Screen standalone resume while revalidating all PBJ authority on every launch, shows an explicit failed-resume state, suppresses competing local-recovery prompts for PBJ sessions, proxies PBJ API requests during local hosting, saves debounced whole-project snapshots with an immediate size-safe lifecycle flush when Safari backgrounds or closes the app, connects the standard MP4 renderer to PBJ's intent/receipt/approval gates, corrects OpenReel crop presets to calculate aspect ratios in source pixel space, exposes OpenReel's existing clip move through an accessible keyboard shortcut, presents OpenReel's Preview and compact native Timeline together on narrow screens with a fixed center playhead and padded scrolling timeline, places its Assets and Inspector panels in sheets and its existing selected-clip commands in a contextual bottom tray, adapts OpenReel's existing clip move and trim interactions from mouse-only listeners to pointer events with wider narrow-screen trim targets, bypasses the inherited Desktop Only overlay for PBJ sessions without user-agent sniffing, enables safe-area, enforced dynamic-height, standalone, and unlocked-orientation PWA presentation, and scopes PBJ's warm cream, purple, black-action visual continuity and browser theme color to PBJ-launched sessions without changing standalone OpenReel. No editing feature is reimplemented or individually bridged.
adapted_sources.authority_boundary: OpenReel owns editing-session project state, tools, playback, and undo/redo. PBJ owns the initial handoff, media permissions, durable snapshots, approval, and learning.

adapted_sources.name: Troy PB&J Frontend
adapted_sources.modifications: Translated Troy's visual tokens and shared control patterns into PBJ-native server-rendered CSS, added compatibility aliases for the existing PBJ templates, preserved iPhone safe-area and reduced-motion behavior, and copied the approved sandwich artwork without modifying its bytes. No React application state, Clerk authentication, fake project data, simulated rendering, backend service, or Studio code was imported.
adapted_sources.authority_boundary: Troy's source provides presentation only. PBJ owns routes, sessions, project state, jobs, privacy, learning, and the OpenReel handoff; OpenReel remains the editor.
